title: Possible air threats in Latvia`s Balvi and Ludzas municipalities are over
summary: Latvia's National Armed Forces (NBS) issued an orange level alert just before 3 o`clock on Friday, November 27, over a threat to Latvian airspace at Ludzas municipality. The threat was declared over in couple of minutes. Later yellow level alert was issued in Balvu municipality. It was cancelled around 3.29.

title: Kyberturvallisuuskeskuksen viikkokatsaus – 48/2026
summary: M365-tunnusten tietomurrot ovat lisääntyneet merkittävästi. Tietomurtoihin käytetään huijausviestejä, jotka johtavat laitekoodikalasteluun. Huijausketju voi alkaa viattoman näköisellä tarjouspyynnöllä. Tällä viikolla kerromme lisäksi älylaitteiden turvallisesta hankinnasta, reitittimien haavoittuvuudesta ja maanantaina järjestetystä arjen kyberturvallisuuden yleisötilaisuudesta.

title: Bezpieczne zakupy online. Publikujemy praktyczny poradnik
summary: Black Friday, Cyber Monday i okres przedświątecznych zakupów to dla cyberprzestępców sezon wzmożonej aktywności. Przygotowaliśmy krótki poradnik, który w prosty sposób przedstawia najważniejsze zasady bezpiecznych zakupów w sieci, o których warto pamiętać przez cały rok.

title: Latvia, Estonia issue drone warnings overnight amid reported attacks near St Petersburg
summary: Latvia scrambled NATO fighter jets and deployed an interceptor drone after an unidentified unmanned aircraft briefly entered its airspace near the eastern border with Russia overnight, while Estonia issued a warning about a possible aerial threat early Friday.

summary: MOD launches Test and Evaluation Marketplace, a single online portal to help businesses test their tech faster.

summary: Kroatialainen tuomioistuin hyväksyi sukeltajan luovuttamisen Saksaan syyskuussa.

title: "A kind of Tripadvisor" — Russian deserters film their illegal escape into Finland
summary: 'How-to' videos of illegal crossings a growing trend, says the Finnish Border Guard.

title: Estonia's defense tech sector accelerates innovation amid war in Ukraine
summary: Two reported sabotage attacks on Estonian defense firms in the space of six months underscore how Russia's war in Ukraine has spurred rapid local innovation.

title: EDF intel chief: Russia's response to border closure more threats
summary: Russia continued its information warfare and pressure on European countries this week, while Ukrainian forces mounted successful counterattacks and Russian losses remained extremely high, said Col. Ants Kiviselg.

title: Estonian border closure could mean lines of lorries on Latvia-Russia border
summary: Usually, as Christmas and New Year approach, long queues of lorries form at the Latvian-Russian border checkpoints; however, following the introduction of the electronic registration system last autumn, the situation has changed dramatically. What is the situation at the Terehova border checkpoint, particularly in light of Estonia’s decision to close its border with Russia? LSM's Latgale editorial ventured to find out.

title: Spionageverdacht: Ex-BND-Chef Hanning bleibt in Untersuchungshaft
summary: Die Festnahme des Ex-BND-Chefs Hanning hatte im Oktober international Schlagzeilen produziert. Nun steht fest, dass der 80-Jährige vorerst in Haft bleibt. Gegen Hanning wird unter anderem wegen Spionageverdachts ermittelt.

title: Westjordanland: Israelische Politiker sprechen von "jüdischem Terror"
summary: Die Gewalt radikaler Siedler gegen Palästinenser im Westjordanland hat massiv zugenommen. In Israel ist der Begriff "jüdischer Terror" kein Tabu mehr. Doch in der Regierung tobt ein Richtungsstreit. Von Julio Segador.
